title: scrophularia xanthoglossa var. hispidula
intro: Scrophularia xanthoglossa var. hispidula, commonly known as a type of figwort, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia xanthoglossa var. hispidula include its ability to reduce fever, treat respiratory issues, and alleviate symptoms of digestive disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
